# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: multi-tier-app
description: A production-ready multi-tier application (frontend, backend, Postgres) Helm chart
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
kubeVersion: ">=1.21.0-0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
global:
  imagePullSecrets: []
  imageRegistry: ""
  nameOverride: ""
  fullnameOverride: ""

frontend:
  replicaCount: 2
  image:
    repository: nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged
    tag: "1.25-alpine"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 80
  podAnnotations: {}
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
  readinessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 5
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 3
    failureThreshold: 3
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 20
    timeoutSeconds: 3
    failureThreshold: 3
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
  topologySpreadConstraints: []
  extraEnv: []
  config:
    APP_NAME: "frontend"
    BACKEND_BASE_URL: "" # default is computed to http://<release>-backend:<port> if not set
  containerPorts:
    http: 8080

backend:
  replicaCount: 2
  image:
    repository: ghcr.io/example/backend
    tag: "1.0.0"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 8080
  podAnnotations: {}
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 300m
      memory: 512Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 150m
      memory: 256Mi
  readinessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /healthz
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 5
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 3
    failureThreshold: 3
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /healthz
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 20
    timeoutSeconds: 3
    failureThreshold: 3
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
  topologySpreadConstraints: []
  extraEnv: []
  config:
    APP_NAME: "backend"
    DB_HOST: ""   # default is computed to <release>-postgres if not set
    DB_PORT: "5432"
  containerPorts:
    http: 8080

postgres:
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    repository: postgres
    tag: "16.3-alpine"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    port: 5432
  podAnnotations: {}
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 1Gi
    requests:
      cpu: 250m
      memory: 512Mi
  readinessProbe:
    exec:
      command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 5
    failureThreshold: 5
  livenessProbe:
    exec:
      command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
    initialDelaySeconds: 20
    periodSeconds: 20
    timeoutSeconds: 5
    failureThreshold: 5
  persistence:
    enabled: true
    accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
    size: 10Gi
    storageClass: ""
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
  topologySpreadConstraints: []
  config:
    PGDATA: "/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata"
  auth:
    username: "appuser"
    database: "appdb"
    password: ""  # if empty, a random password will be generated and persisted in the Secret

common:
  serviceAccount:
    create: false
    name: ""
  podSecurityContext:
    enabled: true
---
# FILE: templates/frontend-configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
data:
  APP_NAME: {{ quote .Values.frontend.config.APP_NAME }}
  {{- $backendURLDefault := printf "http://%s-backend:%d" .Release.Name (int .Values.backend.service.port) }}
  BACKEND_BASE_URL: {{ quote (default $backendURLDefault .Values.frontend.config.BACKEND_BASE_URL) }}
---
# FILE: templates/backend-configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-backend-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
data:
  APP_NAME: {{ quote .Values.backend.config.APP_NAME }}
  {{- $pgSvc := printf "%s-postgres" .Release.Name }}
  DB_HOST: {{ quote (default $pgSvc .Values.backend.config.DB_HOST) }}
  DB_PORT: {{ quote .Values.backend.config.DB_PORT }}
---
# FILE: templates/postgres-configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
data:
  PGDATA: {{ quote .Values.postgres.config.PGDATA }}
---
# FILE: templates/postgres-auth-secret.yaml
{{- $secretName := printf "%s-postgres-auth" .Release.Name -}}
{{- $existing := (lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace $secretName) -}}
{{- $password := "" -}}
{{- if .Values.postgres.auth.password }}
{{- $password = .Values.postgres.auth.password -}}
{{- else if $existing }}
{{- $password = (index $existing.data "POSTGRES_PASSWORD" | b64dec) -}}
{{- else }}
{{- $password = randAlphaNum 20 -}}
{{- end }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ $secretName }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: {{ default "appuser" .Values.postgres.auth.username | quote }}
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{ $password | quote }}
  POSTGRES_DB: {{ default "appdb" .Values.postgres.auth.database | quote }}
---
# FILE: templates/frontend-deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.frontend.replicaCount }}
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
        app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
      annotations:
        {{- with .Values.frontend.podAnnotations }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
    spec:
      {{- with .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      securityContext:
        {{- if .Values.common.podSecurityContext.enabled }}
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
        {{- end }}
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: {{ if .Values.global.imageRegistry }}{{ printf "%s/%s:%s" .Values.global.imageRegistry .Values.frontend.image.repository .Values.frontend.image.tag }}{{ else }}{{ printf "%s:%s" .Values.frontend.image.repository .Values.frontend.image.tag }}{{ end }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.frontend.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: {{ .Values.frontend.containerPorts.http }}
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend-config
          env:
            {{- with .Values.frontend.extraEnv }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ "ALL" ]
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            runAsUser: 101
            runAsGroup: 101
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.frontend.resources | nindent 12 }}
          readinessProbe:
            {{- toYaml .Values.frontend.readinessProbe | nindent 12 }}
          livenessProbe:
            {{- toYaml .Values.frontend.livenessProbe | nindent 12 }}
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
      {{- with .Values.frontend.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.frontend.affinity }}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.frontend.tolerations }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.frontend.topologySpreadConstraints }}
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/backend-deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-backend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.backend.replicaCount }}
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
        app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
      annotations:
        {{- with .Values.backend.podAnnotations }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
    spec:
      {{- with .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      securityContext:
        {{- if .Values.common.podSecurityContext.enabled }}
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
        {{- end }}
      containers:
        - name: backend
          image: {{ if .Values.global.imageRegistry }}{{ printf "%s/%s:%s" .Values.global.imageRegistry .Values.backend.image.repository .Values.backend.image.tag }}{{ else }}{{ printf "%s:%s" .Values.backend.image.repository .Values.backend.image.tag }}{{ end }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.backend.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: {{ .Values.backend.containerPorts.http }}
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-backend-config
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-auth
          env:
            {{- with .Values.backend.extraEnv }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ "ALL" ]
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            runAsGroup: 10001
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.backend.resources | nindent 12 }}
          readinessProbe:
            {{- toYaml .Values.backend.readinessProbe | nindent 12 }}
          livenessProbe:
            {{- toYaml .Values.backend.livenessProbe | nindent 12 }}
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
      {{- with .Values.backend.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.backend.affinity }}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.backend.tolerations }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.backend.topologySpreadConstraints }}
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/postgres-statefulset.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
spec:
  serviceName: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-hl
  replicas: {{ .Values.postgres.replicaCount }}
  podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
        app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
      annotations:
        {{- with .Values.postgres.podAnnotations }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
    spec:
      {{- with .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      securityContext:
        {{- if .Values.common.podSecurityContext.enabled }}
        runAsNonRoot: true
        fsGroup: 999
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
        {{- end }}
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: {{ if .Values.global.imageRegistry }}{{ printf "%s/%s:%s" .Values.global.imageRegistry .Values.postgres.image.repository .Values.postgres.image.tag }}{{ else }}{{ printf "%s:%s" .Values.postgres.image.repository .Values.postgres.image.tag }}{{ end }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.postgres.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-auth
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-config
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ "ALL" ]
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
            runAsUser: 999
            runAsGroup: 999
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.resources | nindent 12 }}
          readinessProbe:
            {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.readinessProbe | nindent 12 }}
          livenessProbe:
            {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.livenessProbe | nindent 12 }}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.persistence.accessModes | nindent 10 }}
        {{- if .Values.postgres.persistence.storageClass }}
        storageClassName: {{ .Values.postgres.persistence.storageClass }}
        {{- end }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ .Values.postgres.persistence.size }}

      protocol: TCP

metadata:

  labels:

spec:

    limits:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi

    httpGet:
      path: /
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 5
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 3
    failureThreshold: 3
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 20
    timeoutSeconds: 3
    failureThreshold: 3
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
  topologySpreadConstraints: []
  extraEnv: []
  config:
    APP_NAME: "frontend"
    BACKEND_BASE_URL: "" # default is computed to http://<release>-backend:<port> if not set
  containerPorts:
    http: 8080

backend:
  replicaCount: 2
  image:
    repository: ghcr.io/example/backend
    tag: "1.0.0"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 8080
  podAnnotations: {}
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 300m
      memory: 512Mi

      cpu: 150m

    httpGet:
      path: /healthz
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 5
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 3
    failureThreshold: 3
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet:

    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 20
    timeoutSeconds: 3
    failureThreshold: 3
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
  topologySpreadConstraints: []
  extraEnv: []
  config:
    APP_NAME: "backend"
    DB_HOST: ""   # default is computed to <release>-postgres if not set
    DB_PORT: "5432"
  containerPorts:
    http: 8080

  replicaCount: 1

    repository: postgres

    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 5
    failureThreshold: 5
  livenessProbe:
    exec:
      command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
    initialDelaySeconds: 20
    periodSeconds: 20
    timeoutSeconds: 5
    failureThreshold: 5
  persistence:
    enabled: true
    accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
    size: 10Gi
    storageClass: ""
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
  topologySpreadConstraints: []
  config:
    PGDATA: "/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata"
  auth:
    username: "appuser"
    database: "appdb"
    password: ""  # if empty, a random password will be generated and persisted in the Secret

  serviceAccount:
    create: false
    name: ""
  podSecurityContext:
    enabled: true

# FILE: templates/postgres-statefulset.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
spec:
  serviceName: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-hl
  replicas: {{ .Values.postgres.replicaCount }}
  podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: postgres
        app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion }}
      annotations:
        {{- with .Values.postgres.podAnnotations }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
    spec:
      {{- with .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      securityContext:
        {{- if .Values.common.podSecurityContext.enabled }}
        runAsNonRoot: true
        fsGroup: 999
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
        {{- end }}
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: {{ if .Values.global.imageRegistry }}{{ printf "%s/%s:%s" .Values.global.imageRegistry .Values.postgres.image.repository .Values.postgres.image.tag }}{{ else }}{{ printf "%s:%s" .Values.postgres.image.repository .Values.postgres.image.tag }}{{ end }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.postgres.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-auth
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-config
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ "ALL" ]
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
            runAsUser: 999
            runAsGroup: 999
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.resources | nindent 12 }}
          readinessProbe:
            {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.readinessProbe | nindent 12 }}
          livenessProbe:
            {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.livenessProbe | nindent 12 }}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.persistence.accessModes | nindent 10 }}
        {{- if .Values.postgres.persistence.storageClass }}
        storageClassName: {{ .Values.postgres.persistence.storageClass }}
        {{- end }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ .Values.postgres.persistence.size }}
